WITH Avg_Showtimes_Per_Day AS (
    SELECT 
        T1.film_id,
        AVG(T1.show_times_per_day) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.film_id) AS Avg_Showtimes
    FROM
        schedule AS T1
),
Recent_Large_Cinemas AS (
    SELECT Name, Openning_year, Capacity, Location 
    FROM cinema
    WHERE Openning_year > 2010
    UNION
    SELECT Name, Openning_year, Capacity, Location 
    FROM cinema
    WHERE Capacity > 500
)

    T3.name AS Cinema_Name,
    T2.Title AS Film_Title,
    T1.Date AS Schedule_Date,
    T1.Price AS Ticket_Price,
    ASPD.Avg_Showtimes
FROM 
    schedule AS T1 
JOIN 
    film AS T2 ON T1.film_id = T2.film_id 
JOIN 
    cinema AS T3 ON T1.cinema_id = T3.cinema_id
LEFT JOIN 
    Avg_Showtimes_Per_Day AS ASPD ON T1.film_id = ASPD.film_id
JOIN 
    Recent_Large_Cinemas AS RLC ON T3.name = RLC.Name;

IntersectedClasses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Class FROM RankedRaces
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT Class FROM RecursiveRaces
)
SELECT * FROM IntersectedClasses;
